lines.sub: Ek sponge. Sirf ek sponge. Aur iski bikri saikdon million dollar mein.
Ye kahani hai Scrub Daddy ki.
Aaron Krause gaadiyan chamkane wale pad banate the. Unhone ek ajeeb foam banaya.
Thande paani mein ye sakht ho jaata. Aur garam paani mein ekdum naram.
Kuch saal wo foam bas garage mein pada raha. Kisi ko khaas nahi laga.
Phir unhone use ek muskurate chehre ki shakal mein kaat diya.
Aankhon mein ungliyan phansti hain. Aur munh se chammach ke dono taraf ek saath safaai.
2012. Shark Tank. Lori Greiner ne paisa lagaya.
TV shopping par kuch hi minuton mein hazaaron sponge bik gaye.
Aaj ise Shark Tank ki sabse badi kaamyabiyon mein gina jaata hai.
Sabak: boring product ko ek chehra do, aur ek demo. Log yaad rakhenge.
Aisi aur kahaniyon ke liye, follow karo!
